HomePage.title: Turning ideas into creative solutions.
HomePage.description: Innovative web developer crafting unique user experiences.

weather-app.title: Weather App
weather-app.description: A web application allowing users to view current weather and forecasts for their city of choice. The application provides an intuitive interface with real-time weather data.

web-documentary.title: Web Documentary
web-documentary.description: A second-year DUT MMI (S3) project exploring dating applications, focusing on male experiences. The project aims to uncover the challenges of these platforms by blending interactivity and credibility.

data-visualization.title: Data Visualization
data-visualization.description: Second-year project in the DUT MMI (S3), this site provides cinema data analysis through APIs, displaying information via two graphs.

translate-app.title: Translate App
translate-app.description: A web application offering translation of up to 500 characters in various languages, with the ability to listen to and copy texts, including in English and French.
